conclusion.statement: In an isolated local environment (loopback uvicorn on 127.0.0.1:8017 with APP_ENV=development, AUTH_SECRET cleared, VOICE_MODE=local, and a one-off gitignored SQLite), the full release-check ran all 10 checks for real and all passed: exit code 0, execution_scope=full, all_green=true, 10/10 pass including the three live checks voice/license/e2e. This proves the full gate pipeline runs end-to-end on a local surface. It is NOT a production-environment release gate: the runtime surface is development/auth-off/SQLite/local-voice/loopback, so it must not be read as production readiness or production release authorization; production_ready stays false.
